method: independent source, Appendix A.7, controlled-vocabulary, existing-identity, closed-registry, code-owned-handler, exactness and no-fallback audit
rationale: The existing comparative schedule remains approved. The separate reaction policy reuses exactly the three previously approved command identities; handler, input/consequence contract, effect and successor mappings match the closed registry and code-owned handlers. Perception filters are closed, not_perceived is excluded, zero/one/many behavior is fail-closed, and no default, fallback or state patch is present.
limitations: The schedule is a labeled comparative reconstruction and is not a generic schedule for all Novgorod NPCs or direct evidence of Orthodox monastic observance.
The reaction policy is bounded gameplay reconstruction, not evidence of historical NPC behavior, and does not create capabilities, authority relations, safe anchors or threats.
